situation: What actually gets quantized in an MCP+LLM system.
decision: Tool definitions and validated tool results can be shared across models; quantize model weights, activations, vision encoders, audio components, and KV caches — never the tools.
reasoning_physics: Tools are contracts (schemas/names/ordering) that compress to nothing and are qualitization-proof; weights/activations/KV are parametric state that compress with loss. Sharing schema is lossless; sharing KV/embeddings across models is not.
